grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' contrast 3.02:1 (amber on amber tint, 16px bold)
grader_mapping.reason: Amber #bd7d0f text on a #fbefda tint at 16px bold measuring about 3.0:1 is the 'Few left' tag contrast failure.

grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The slot grid runs 15 px past the viewport at 320 px and the page scrolls sideways.

grader_mapping.title: No visible focus on slot button 08:00
grader_mapping.reason: Focusing a slot button changes no pixels, so there is no visible focus on the slot buttons.

grader_mapping.title: Focus order jumps back from 08:00 to 08:20 Few left
grader_mapping.reason: Focus jumps around the grid because the 'Few left' slots are moved visually out of DOM order.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled-booking page keeps the heading 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: The cancelled state comes only from the double press. D09 covers the done page that still reads 'Booked' while the booking is cancelled, which is narrower than D09 but the same harm.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled-booking page title reads 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: The same misleading cancelled done page that D09 describes ('is titled Booked'), reported through the page title.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-slot error gives no recovery step; slot shown as '—'
grader_mapping.reason: After the hold lapses, the slot is dropped and the summary shows a dash with only 'This slot is no longer available.' This is the D08 expired-hold harm.

grader_mapping.title: Selected day barely distinguishable under forced colours
grader_mapping.reason: Residents who use Windows high-contrast or forced colours can hardly see which day button is pressed: only a 1 px border difference shows it, while other selected controls get the Highlight colour. The day named in text softens this but does not remove it.

grader_mapping.title: Second press of 'Book this slot' cancels the booking
grader_mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s wait turns the booking into a cancellation, and the done page still says 'Booked'.

grader_mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no pending state during the 1.5 s wait
grader_mapping.reason: Book stays enabled and shows no progress while the booking is made. The instructions place this under D09.

grader_mapping.title: Slot list has no loading state; Next silently does nothing
grader_mapping.reason: The grid and status line are blank for about 0.9 s with nothing marking the wait, and Next returns without feedback. This is the D01 wait.

grader_mapping.title: Today's past slots offered as free, refused only after Book
grader_mapping.reason: Today's slots that have started are shown as free and are refused only at the final submit.

grader_mapping.title: Permit not checked on the vehicle step, only after Book
grader_mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty or malformed permit, and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field.

grader_mapping.title: Post-Book errors (permit, past slot, expired hold) not linked to their fix
grader_mapping.reason: The states named are the permit errors after Book. The resident must work out how to get back to the vehicle step, which is the D07 confirm-page permit error.

grader_mapping.title: 5-minute hold expires with no warning, display or extension
grader_mapping.reason: The five-minute hold runs out unseen and the slot is dropped at submit.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle-step error summary links target non-focusable containers
grader_mapping.reason: Keyboard and screen-reader residents who activate an error link are not put on the vehicle buttons or waste checkboxes they need to fix. They have to hunt for the control after an error.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown with Car chosen, no 'vans and trailers only' wording
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule is not stated at the field and its explanation sits behind the icon-only info button. Stating the rule at the field would fix that part of D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Booked' page does not restate day, time window or vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page is missing the day, the slot and the vehicle.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' opens a blank first step, forgetting the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' opens with Today pressed and no slot chosen, and nothing says what is kept.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown and labelled the same for every vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The rule that only vans and trailers need a permit is stated only behind the info button and on the first page, not where the field is.

grader_mapping.title: Permit rule hidden behind an icon-only (i) button
grader_mapping.reason: This is the D07 rule hidden behind an icon-only info button.

grader_mapping.title: Permit help has no link to apply and no timing
grader_mapping.reason: A van owner booking the evening before is told to apply on the council site but gets no link and no word on whether a permit can arrive in time. They cannot act on it from the page.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step does not repeat the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: The choice is shown again on the confirm page before booking, which is the usual check-your-answers pattern. Any harm from leaving it off the middle step is speculative.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking
grader_mapping.reason: Residents book in the evening or at weekends, but changing or freeing a slot needs a weekday phone call. Someone whose plans change at the weekend cannot move or release the slot.

grader_mapping.title: No screen says how long a chosen slot is held
grader_mapping.reason: The hold and its end are shown nowhere, which is D08.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking (duplicate)
grader_mapping.reason: The same unseeded problem as F-0067: residents who change a booking at their usual time, outside weekday phone hours, have no way to do it.

grader_mapping.title: No indication anywhere of the hold time
grader_mapping.reason: No page shows the hold time or time remaining before 'This slot is no longer available'. This is D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled out of time order into an unlabelled group
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' slots are moved to the front of the grid, out of time order and away from their Morning/Afternoon headings.

grader_mapping.title: Done page lacks booked day, time and vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page is missing the day, the slot and the vehicle.

grader_mapping.title: Expired hold keeps 'Book this slot' as primary while slot shows '–'
grader_mapping.reason: This describes how the confirm page behaves when the hold has lapsed: the slot is replaced by a dash and the page offers no way forward. That is the D08 harm.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown before a vehicle is chosen; rule behind (i)
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule is stated only behind the info button, which is D07.

grader_mapping.title: At 320 px the slot grid is wider than the header rule and card
grader_mapping.reason: The slot grid overflows to a 335 px page at 320 px. This is the same overflow seen from its visual side.

grader_mapping.title: Slot-count status not announced (live region inserted with its text)
grader_mapping.reason: The status line '20 slots free on ...' gets aria-live only together with its text, so screen readers are not told about the slots.

grader_mapping.title: No progress during the 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
grader_mapping.reason: Choosing a permit vehicle takes 1.2 s before the permit field appears, with nothing shown meanwhile. The instructions place the delayed permit field under D07.

grader_mapping.title: Layout shift above the 0.1 budget on / (moves #opening)
grader_mapping.reason: CLS is 0.169 when the slots arrive, and #opening moves. This is the D02 page jump.

grader_mapping.title: Slot count status message not announced
grader_mapping.reason: The '20 slots free on ...' line is not announced because its live region is created together with the text. This is the D11 screen-reader harm.

grader_mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot 08:00
grader_mapping.reason: Focusing a slot button shows nothing, which is the missing focus ring on slot buttons.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots in a separate block above Morning, out of DOM and time order
grader_mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots are moved to the front out of time order, so the reading/focus order and headings no longer match the screen.

grader_mapping.title: Selected day not distinguishable under forced colours
grader_mapping.reason: In Windows high-contrast mode the pressed day looks like the others, so a low-vision resident cannot see which day is chosen and has to read the line below. The text restatement makes this minor, but it is a real loss of the selected-state cue.

grader_mapping.title: Done page heading says 'Booked' for a cancelled booking
grader_mapping.reason: D09 includes the cancelled booking's done page still titled 'Booked' with 'Show this at the gate'. This is the misleading outcome of the double press.

grader_mapping.title: Current step in the Steps list marked only by bold
grader_mapping.reason: Without aria-current or another programmatic state, a screen-reader user cannot tell which of the three steps they are on (1.3.1). This is a genuine accessibility gap that the ground truth does not seed.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-hold error gives no next step
grader_mapping.reason: When the hold lapses, the slot is dropped with only 'This slot is no longer available.' and no explanation or route on. This is the D08 harm.

grader_mapping.title: Injected .slot:focus rule removes focus indicator
grader_mapping.reason: This is the run-time injected style that removes the slot buttons' outline with no replacement.

grader_mapping.title: Double activation of 'Book this slot' cancels the booking
grader_mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s wait turns the booking into a cancellation.

grader_mapping.title: Booking wait and slot loading show no visible progress
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The finding joins two waits, but only its slot-loading half covers a whole defect: 'Changing day clears the slot grid and status text and waits 900 ms with nothing in its place; during that time the When page's Next button returns silently ... with no message' has all three parts of D01 (empty grid, blank status line, Next doing nothing). The booking half ('the button looks unchanged') is D09's no-progress symptom only. It never mentions a second press or the cancellation, which F-0027 covers. Fixing what the item describes would fix D01 in full but not D09's harm.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid at 360 px and below wider than its container
grader_mapping.reason: The script sizes the grid columns from the window width, so at 360 px and below the grid overflows by about 32 px.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown for every vehicle (hidden overridden), delayed reveal has no effect
grader_mapping.reason: It concerns the permit field's conditional, 1200 ms-delayed reveal on the vehicle step. The instructions place the permit rule and the delayed permit field under D07.

grader_mapping.title: Today's past slots offered as free, rejected only at final booking
grader_mapping.reason: Today's already-started slots are selectable and only refused after Book, with an unlinked error.

grader_mapping.title: Permit format and closed-day checks only at final booking, unlinked
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field and no link back. This is D07's 'A van needs a permit number' harm.

grader_mapping.title: Five-minute hold expires with no warning or extension
grader_mapping.reason: The unseen five-minute hold runs out and the slot is dropped.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag below 4.5:1 contrast
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' text is about 3.0:1 in light mode and about 3.4:1 in dark mode against the 4.5:1 required.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' colours not DESIGN.md roles
grader_mapping.reason: It concerns the same tag's colours under 1.4.3. Using the declared warning role, as the item asks, would fix the contrast failure.

grader_mapping.title: Slot end time and arrival rule only in a title tooltip
grader_mapping.reason: The slot end time and 'arrive within your slot' appear only on hover, never on a phone.

grader_mapping.title: No loading indication while slots load
grader_mapping.reason: The Slots area is blank with nothing saying slots are coming. This is the wait itself.

grader_mapping.title: No in-progress indication while booking is submitted
grader_mapping.reason: Book does nothing visible for 1.3 to 1.5 s, which D09 names as the cause of the second press.

grader_mapping.title: No notice that the slot is held or for how long
grader_mapping.reason: No page shows the hold or when it ends.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-slot error does not explain or guide recovery
grader_mapping.reason: After the hold lapses, the slot becomes a dash with 'no longer available' and no explanation or prompt to choose a new slot.

grader_mapping.title: Booked page lacks day, slot time and vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page shows the reference but not the day, slot or vehicle.

grader_mapping.title: Change slot opens a fresh booking page with no sign of the change
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' opens the first step on Today with no slot chosen, forgetting the chosen day and slot.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step does not show the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: The flow has a 'Check and book' step that restates every choice before booking, so the earlier choice not appearing on step 2 is a design preference, not a harm the review shows.

grader_mapping.title: Change slot and Back to the slots reopen on Today
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and reopens on Today. 'Back to the slots' is the same problem on the vehicle step.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking
grader_mapping.reason: The only route is a weekday-daytime phone line, while residents book in the evening or for weekends. Someone who cannot come has no way to free or move the slot when the line is closed.

grader_mapping.title: Slot list goes blank under the previous day's date while loading
grader_mapping.reason: The grid is empty with no loading message while slots arrive. This is the D01 wait, made worse by the stale day label.

grader_mapping.title: Slots already started today can be chosen
grader_mapping.reason: Today's already-started slots (08:00 to 10:00 at 10:05) are offered as free and selectable.

grader_mapping.title: Mobile number required though hinted as only for a reminder
grader_mapping.reason: The hint reads as optional, but a blank number or a landline blocks booking. Landline-only residents, often older, cannot book at all.

grader_mapping.title: Permit help says apply on council site but gives no link
grader_mapping.reason: A van or trailer owner who learns they need a permit is given no link or address to apply, so they cannot finish the task without searching elsewhere.

grader_mapping.title: Waste can only be changed via a link labelled 'Change vehicle'
grader_mapping.reason: On Check and book the Waste row has no change link, and the link that leads to the waste checkboxes is labelled 'Change vehicle', so a resident wanting to fix their waste list cannot see how.

grader_mapping.title: After an invalid date, slots area still shows previous result
grader_mapping.reason: The review says a clear inline error is shown, and the stale area is labelled with its own day (Wednesday 14), so it shows no plausible harm to residents.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled out of time order into an unlabelled group
grader_mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots are moved ahead of the Morning and Afternoon grids, out of time order.

grader_mapping.title: Done page shows reference but not day, slot or vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page omits the day, the 20-minute slot and the vehicle.

grader_mapping.title: axe color-contrast failure on 'Few left' (3.02:1)
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: #bd7d0f on #fbefda at 16 px bold is 3.02:1, which is the 'Few left' tag contrast.

grader_mapping.title: Text contrast below 4.5:1 on 'Few left'
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: 'Few left' is 3.02:1 in the light theme.

grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: at 320 px the slots area extends 15 px past the viewport, so the page scrolls sideways.

grader_mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: this is the same slot-grid overflow at 320 px, recorded under 1.4.10.

grader_mapping.title: Focus order jumps back from 08:00 to 08:20 Few left
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: Tab follows DOM time order while 'Few left' slots are shown first, so focus jumps around the grid.

grader_mapping.title: No progress during 1.2 s operation after 'Car with trailer'
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: choosing a permit vehicle triggers the 1.2 s delayed permit-field reveal with nothing shown meanwhile. This is D07's delayed permit field.

grader_mapping.title: Layout shift above 0.1 budget (#opening moved)
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: the layout shift (CLS 0.169) moves #opening when the slots arrive.

grader_mapping.title: Current step shown only by bold, not exposed to screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: The review's own reply says the markup does mark the current step with aria-current="step" and calls this a probable false alarm, so the claim is wrong on the review's own evidence.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots pulled above the Morning heading, out of their group
grader_mapping.reason: CSS order:-1 moves 'Few left' slots to the front, so the Morning and Afternoon headings no longer sit above their slots. That is the D10 reordering.

grader_mapping.title: Selected day button barely distinguishable from unselected days
grader_mapping.reason: The pressed day differs only by a 1 px thicker border and a 1.16:1 tint, so a resident, especially one with low vision or using forced colours, cannot easily confirm which day they are booking. No seeded defect covers this.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled booking page headed 'Booked' and says show it at the gate
grader_mapping.reason: D09 includes the cancelled done page that is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate', which is how a resident ends up at the gate with a cancelled booking.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' returns with Today selected, not the booked day
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and reopens on today. That is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-slot message gives no next step and blanks the slot
grader_mapping.reason: This is the lapsed hold: 'This slot is no longer available.' with the slot line turned into a dash, without saying the hold ran out. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: Slot button focus outline removed with no replacement
grader_mapping.reason: The injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' leaves the slot buttons with no visible focus. That is D05.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved ahead of time order, visual and focus order diverge
grader_mapping.reason: Per-button order:-1 pulls 'Few left' slots out of time order while Tab keeps DOM order. That is D10.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid wider than content box at 360 px and below
grader_mapping.reason: The script sizes the columns from the window width, not the content box, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below. That is D04.

grader_mapping.title: Book this slot shows no visible change during its 1.5 s wait
grader_mapping.reason: Book doing nothing visible while the booking is made is part of D09.

grader_mapping.title: Second tap on Book saves the booking as cancelled
grader_mapping.reason: A second press during the pending wait turns the booking into a cancellation. That is the core of D09.

grader_mapping.title: Done page heading says 'Booked' when the status is cancelled
grader_mapping.reason: This is the same cancelled-but-titled-'Booked' done page that D09 describes.

grader_mapping.title: Slot list empty with no loading indicator after a day change
grader_mapping.reason: The grid and status line stay empty for 0.9 s with nothing saying slots are coming. That is the D01 wait.

grader_mapping.title: Next does nothing while slots are loading
grader_mapping.reason: D01 explicitly includes Next doing nothing during the load.

grader_mapping.title: Slots already past today offered as free, rejected only at booking
grader_mapping.reason: Today's slots that have started are offered and then refused at the final step. That is D06.

grader_mapping.title: Returning to the when step drops the saved day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: This is a broader statement of 'Change slot' landing on today with nothing selected. Fixing it fixes D12.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag colours below 4.5:1
grader_mapping.reason: The run-time 'few' colours give about 3.0:1 (light) and 3.4:1 (dark) for 16 px bold text. That is D03.

grader_mapping.title: Permit not checked on vehicle step; error only after booking, no link
grader_mapping.reason: Next accepting an empty permit, with the rule enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field, is D07.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step error summary links do not move focus to a control
grader_mapping.reason: Activating an error link scrolls to a container but focuses nothing, so a keyboard or switch user has to hunt for the vehicle or waste control they must fix. No seeded defect covers this.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle and waste errors not programmatically tied to controls
grader_mapping.reason: The finding is speculative by its own wording ('do not appear to be', 'may not announce', 'this needs an accessibility-tree check'), with no evidence that the association is actually missing.

grader_mapping.title: 5-minute slot hold never disclosed
grader_mapping.reason: No page shows the five-minute hold, and it lapses unseen. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-hold error does not say the hold expired or link to another slot
grader_mapping.reason: This is the D08 message, 'This slot is no longer available.', with the slot dropped and no reason given.

grader_mapping.title: Slot area shows the previous day's caption over an empty list while loading
grader_mapping.reason: The grid is empty for about a second with no loading text, so nothing says slots are coming. That is the D01 wait.

grader_mapping.title: Slot hold and its time limit not stated after choosing a slot
grader_mapping.reason: The hold and its length are never shown, and the only signal is the final-step error. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown and unmarked for cars; explanation behind an 'i' icon
grader_mapping.reason: This is about the permit rule: the field is not labelled vans-and-trailers-only, and the explanation sits behind the icon-only info button. Both are part of D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no pending state
grader_mapping.reason: Book staying unchanged and enabled for about 1.5 s is the 'Book doing nothing visible' part of D09.

grader_mapping.title: Confirmation omits the day, the arrival window and the vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, the slot and the vehicle. That is D14.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step does not show the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: The check step restates the day, slot and 20-minute window with Change links, as the reply notes. Not repeating them mid-flow is a design choice with no harm shown.

grader_mapping.title: Permit help says apply on the council site but gives no link
grader_mapping.reason: A van or trailer owner who learns they need a permit is told to apply elsewhere with no link, so they have to search the council site on their phone to continue. No seeded defect covers this.

grader_mapping.title: Two-working-day permit lead time revealed only after a slot is chosen
grader_mapping.reason: The permit information is held inside the collapsed 'About vans and trailers' panel behind the icon-only button. That is the hidden permit rule in D07.

grader_mapping.title: No way to change or cancel an existing booking online
grader_mapping.reason: Residents book in the evening for weekend visits, but changing or cancelling needs a weekday 09:00-17:00 phone call, so they cannot move a booking when they need to. D12 is only the in-flow 'Change slot', so this is not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Vans and trailers help is an unlabelled icon among the vehicle buttons
grader_mapping.reason: D07 says the permit rule is given only behind an icon-only info button. This finding is that button.

grader_mapping.title: Past slots on Today offered as free, rejected at the final step
grader_mapping.reason: Today's past slots are selectable and refused only after Book. That is D06.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' reopens on Today, not the booked day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day, including after an expired hold. That is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Invalid 'Another day' date leaves the previous day's slots selectable
grader_mapping.reason: After a bad date, Today's grid stays live under the error, so a resident can pick a slot and book a day they did not ask for. No seeded defect covers this.

grader_mapping.title: Keyboard focus on slot buttons has no visible indicator
grader_mapping.reason: Tabbing to a slot shows no ring or change. That is D05.

grader_mapping.title: No indication of how long a chosen slot is held
grader_mapping.reason: No page shows the hold, its length or the time left. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking
grader_mapping.reason: This duplicates F-0058: the only route is a weekday phone line while residents book in evenings and visit at weekends, so they cannot change a booking when they need to. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.reason: 3.02:1 for 16 px bold #bd7d0f on #fbefda. That is the D03 'Few left' tag contrast.

grader_mapping.reason: 'Few left' at 3.02:1 is D03.

grader_mapping.reason: The page scrolls sideways at 320 px because of the slot area. That is D04.

grader_mapping.reason: This is the same overflow at 320 px, caused by the slot grid. That is D04.

grader_mapping.reason: Focusing a slot button changes no pixels. That is D05.

grader_mapping.title: Book twice cancels the booking; done page still says Booked; button shows no progress
grader_mapping.reason: Book shows no busy state for about 1.5 s, a second tap turns into cancel, and the done page is still headed 'Booked' with a small cancelled line. This is D09 exactly.

grader_mapping.title: Five-minute slot hold runs out unseen and the slot is dropped
grader_mapping.reason: No page mentions the hold. When it lapses, Book says 'This slot is no longer available', the summary shows a dash and there is no link back. This is the hold running out unseen and the slot being dropped.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shows even for a car, suggesting every resident needs a permit
grader_mapping.reason: This is a separate problem in the same paragraph. The review says a stylesheet rule overrides the hidden attribute, so car drivers see 'Permit number' and may think they need a permit or abandon the booking. Hiding the field for cars would not fix D07's late, unexplained enforcement, so it is not that defect.

grader_mapping.title: Van with no permit passes the vehicle step and is rejected only on the confirm page; 1.2 s field delay
grader_mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty permit, the rule is enforced on the last step with an error that has no link to a field on the previous page, and the field appears after a 1.2-second delay. The instructions put all of these under D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and reopens on Today
grader_mapping.reason: From the check step, 'Change slot' opens on Today instead of the chosen Saturday, so the booking can quietly move to the wrong day. This is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid wider than the screen at 360 px and 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Below 361 px the script sets fixed column widths, the page scrolls sideways by 14–15 px and the right column is cut off. This matches D04 exactly.

grader_mapping.title: Slot buttons have no visible focus
grader_mapping.reason: The injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' removes the focus ring from every slot button, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on. This is D05.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved to the top, out of time order; visual order does not match reading order
grader_mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots jump above the Morning heading, so afternoon slots sit among morning ones while screen reader and keyboard order stay chronological. This is D10.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag fails text contrast
grader_mapping.reason: The review measures 3.0:1 in light mode and 3.4:1 in dark mode against the 4.5:1 required for the 'Few left' tag. This is the D03 contrast failure.

grader_mapping.title: Today's past slots shown as free and refused only at the end
grader_mapping.reason: Earlier slots today such as 08:00, and those inside the 30-minute cut-off, can be chosen and are rejected only after the details are typed. This is D06.

grader_mapping.title: No loading state while slots arrive; Next does nothing
grader_mapping.reason: The grid stays empty for about a second with no message, and pressing Next in that time does nothing. This is the wait itself, which is D01.

grader_mapping.title: Selected slot barely distinguishable, especially in dark mode
grader_mapping.reason: The selected background is 1.4:1 in dark mode and 1.2:1 in light mode against unselected slots, marked only by a slightly thicker border. Residents on a phone may not be able to tell which slot they chose. This is a non-text contrast problem that is not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Slot length and arrival rule only in a tooltip
grader_mapping.reason: The 20-minute length and 'arrive within your slot' are only in a title tooltip that phones never show. This is D13.

grader_mapping.title: Phone hint 'For a reminder' makes a required mobile number sound optional
grader_mapping.reason: Residents may leave the number out, thinking it optional, and then hit an error, and people without a UK mobile cannot book. This is a genuine form-labelling problem that is not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Opening done.html directly shows a made-up reference DR-000000
grader_mapping.reason: Settled. The review says only 'Opening done.html directly shows a made-up reference, "DR-000000"' (repeated as 'Opening the "Booked" page directly shows a made-up reference'). It lists this under 'Smaller points' and gives no way a resident would reach that page without booking, and no cost to them. The behaviour was reproduced, but the harm to residents is speculative without basis in what the review shows. The history or bookmark scenario is the grader's, not the review's. It is not D14, which is about the day, slot and vehicle missing from the page.

grader_mapping.title: First 'N slots free' update not announced to screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: aria-live is switched on only after the first count has been written, so a screen reader never hears that the slots arrived or how many there are. This is D11.

grader_mapping.title: 'Today' hard-coded as 12 October 2026, so no day after 26 October can be booked
grader_mapping.reason: This is the fixture's fixed demo clock (the site's 'today' is set to Monday 12 October). The review itself says it 'may just be demo data' and raises it as a question for the agency, not as a problem residents meet in this flow.

runs.name: audit-standard-slot-booking
failed: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person

grader_mapping.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking while the page says 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: Nothing changes for 1.5 s after the first tap, a second tap turns the button into a cancel, and the done page still says 'Booked' with a small 'cancelled' line. That is D09.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved to the top, out of time order and above the Morning heading
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' slots are pulled to the front of the grid, out of time order and out from under their headings, and screen readers and keyboards follow a different order (WCAG 1.3.2/2.4.3). This is D10.

grader_mapping.title: Reference page lacks day, time, vehicle and waste
grader_mapping.reason: The done page shows only the reference and not the day, slot or vehicle that residents and the gate check. That is D14.

grader_mapping.title: Same-day slots that have gone are offered and refused at the last step
grader_mapping.reason: Today's 08:00 slot is shown as free and is refused only after all the details are filled in ('can no longer be booked'). That is D06.

grader_mapping.title: Unmentioned 5-minute hold expires; error has no link back and slot becomes a dash
grader_mapping.reason: The hold is never shown, it runs out unseen, the slot is dropped (the summary shows '—') and the error offers no way back. That matches D08.

grader_mapping.title: Missing van/trailer permit caught only at the end, with no link back
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule is enforced only on the confirm page and the resident has no direct way back to the field. The instructions put this under D07.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown for every vehicle, including cars (CSS overrides hidden)
grader_mapping.reason: This is a different harm from D07. Car drivers see a permit field they don't need and may think they need a permit, and the review cites the cause (.field{display:flex} overriding [hidden]). Hiding the field would not fix D07, so it does not map there.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field for vans revealed after 1.2 s and not announced
grader_mapping.reason: The permit field appears late and nothing draws attention to it, which is D07's delayed permit field.

grader_mapping.title: Slot buttons have no visible focus outline
grader_mapping.reason: An injected .slot:focus{outline:0} removes the focus ring from the slot buttons, so keyboard users can't see where they are. That is D05.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' returns to Today instead of the chosen day
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and opens on today, so the resident has to find Saturday again. That is D12.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' label contrast too low (3.0:1 light, 3.4:1 dark)
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' tag is 16 px bold text below 4.5:1 in both themes. That is D03.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid scrolls sideways at 360 px and below and at 200% zoom
grader_mapping.reason: The script sets column widths that ignore the page padding, so the page scrolls sideways by 14-15 px at 360/320 px. Zoom on a larger phone brings the width under the same threshold, so this is all D04.

grader_mapping.title: Nothing visible while slots load; Next taps ignored
grader_mapping.reason: For about a second the slot area is empty and silent and Next does nothing. That is the wait itself, D01.

grader_mapping.title: 'Arrive within your slot' only in a tooltip
grader_mapping.reason: Slot details that matter (arrive within the slot) are only in a tooltip, which phones never show. That is D13.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle-page error links point to containers that can't take focus
grader_mapping.reason: Tapping 'Choose the vehicle…' or 'Choose at least one kind of waste' moves the resident nowhere, so keyboard, screen-reader and phone users can't get from the error to the control that needs fixing. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Waste hint no longer read out after an error
grader_mapping.reason: Once an error shows, screen-reader users lose the hint about which waste to choose, just when they need it. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle choice better as radio buttons than toggle buttons
grader_mapping.reason: This is a design preference ('would work better') with no harm described or shown.

grader_mapping.title: Registration field should auto-capitalise and turn off spellcheck
grader_mapping.reason: The review's only words for this are 'Smaller items: the registration field should capitalise automatically and turn off spellcheck'. That is a best-practice recommendation. It reports no mistyped or autocorrected plate and no harm at the gate, and it never mentions autocorrect. The harm in B's reason comes from B, not from the review. Under the mapping rules (judge each item on what it says; speculative without basis in what the review shows) this is not-a-problem, the same call both graders made for the harmless 'would work better' remark in R17.

grader_mapping.title: Cancellation only by phoning on a weekday, though the centre opens at weekends
grader_mapping.reason: A resident with a weekend slot who can't come has no way to cancel on the day, so they lose the slot or can't free it. A real gap in the flow, not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Dark-mode colours set by script; default colours show first if it is slow or fails
grader_mapping.reason: Speculative and cosmetic. It is a possible brief flash of default colours, the review observed no harm, and if the script fails the slot flow doesn't work anyway.

grader_mapping.title: 'Today' and quick-day buttons fixed at 12 October 2026
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed date is the scenario's clock (the ground truth says today is Monday 12 October), not a defect residents meet in this flow. The review itself presents it as an unverified question for the agency.

grader_mapping.title: No booking system behind the site; availability and reference made up in the browser
grader_mapping.reason: This is a guess from the code about the build's back end, which the review says it could not test. It is not a usability or accessibility problem in the flow residents use.

grader_mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking; no busy state; done page still headed 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: Book shows nothing for 1.5 s, a second tap saves the booking as cancelled, and the page is still titled 'Booked'. This is exactly D09.

grader_mapping.title: 5-minute hold runs out unseen; slot becomes a dash with 'no longer available' and no way back
grader_mapping.reason: The hold is never shown, and when it lapses the slot line turns to '—' with 'This slot is no longer available.' This is the D08 harm.

grader_mapping.title: Today's past or imminent slots shown as free, refused only at the last step
grader_mapping.reason: Slots that have passed or start within 30 minutes can be chosen, and the refusal comes on the final step after the details are typed. This matches D06.

grader_mapping.title: Van/trailer permit not checked on vehicle step; fails at the end with no link back to the field
grader_mapping.reason: It covers the permit field's behaviour, Next accepting an empty permit, and the confirm page's 'A van needs a permit number' error with no route back. The instructions put all of these under D07.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid wider than the screen at 320/360 px; page scrolls sideways, right column cut off
grader_mapping.reason: A script sizes the grid columns without the page margins, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below. This is D04.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots jump to the top of the grid, out of time order and reading/focus order
grader_mapping.reason: The order:-1 style moves 'Few left' slots ahead of the Morning heading, so the screen order and the keyboard/screen-reader order differ. This is D10.

grader_mapping.title: Slot buttons show no keyboard focus
grader_mapping.reason: An injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' hides the focus ring on every slot button. This is D05.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag contrast below 4.5:1 in light and dark themes
grader_mapping.reason: It reports 3.0:1 light and 3.4:1 dark against the 4.5:1 requirement for the 'Few left' tag. This is D03.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and opens on Today
grader_mapping.reason: Going back from the check step opens on 'Today' with nothing selected, while the vehicle and details are kept. This is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Confirmation page shows only the reference, not day, slot or vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Booked' page lacks the day, time and vehicle that residents need to check at the gate. This is D14.

grader_mapping.title: No loading message while slots arrive; Next does nothing meanwhile
grader_mapping.reason: Slots take about a second, nothing shows in the meantime, and tapping Next does nothing. This is the wait itself, D01.

grader_mapping.title: 'Another day' date field asks for DD/MM/YYYY but iPhone numeric keypad has no '/'
grader_mapping.reason: Residents book mostly on phones. A required format they cannot type on the keypad offered, with no hint that digits alone work, can block or confuse them when picking a day beyond the preset buttons. This is not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Slot length / arrive-within-slot only in a tooltip phones never show
grader_mapping.reason: The slot length and 'Arrive within your slot' are only in a hover tooltip, which never appears on a phone. This is D13.

grader_mapping.title: Mobile number required though only used for a reminder
grader_mapping.reason: Making a reminder-only field mandatory stops residents without a mobile phone from booking at all, so it locks them out of the service. It is not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: First slot count not announced to screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: aria-live is applied only after the first update, so screen readers miss the day's slot count. This is D11.

grader_mapping.title: 'Today' fixed to 12 October 2026 and day buttons hard-coded
grader_mapping.reason: This is about the review build's stubbed date, which the review itself calls an inference and possibly a demo stub. It is not a usability problem residents meet in the flow as built.

grader_mapping.title: Slots and bookings look like placeholders; no server request
grader_mapping.reason: This is a back-end/demo-stub concern the review flags as unconfirmed inference. It describes no interface harm to residents using the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking, but the done page still says 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: The button gives no feedback during the 1.5 s wait, and a second tap cancels the booking while the done page still says 'Booked'. This is the same harm as D09.

grader_mapping.title: 'Today' is hard-coded as Monday 12 October 2026, so the quick-day buttons and the 14-day window are stale
grader_mapping.reason: The fixed date is the fixture's simulated clock: the ground truth itself says today is Monday 12 October at 10:05. The review also guesses it is a demo setting. A resident in this flow is not hurt by it. (The passed-slot part of the same paragraph is R3.)

grader_mapping.title: The slot list ignores the clock, so today's slots that have passed or are about to start show as free
grader_mapping.reason: The review says today's slots that have already passed still show as free. Its fix (hide or disable same-day slots that start less than 30 minutes from now) would fix D06, which is today's started or about-to-start slots being offered and then refused.

grader_mapping.title: The 5-minute slot hold is never shown, is only checked at Book, and gives a misleading 'no longer available' with no link back
grader_mapping.reason: The five-minute hold runs out unseen and the slot is dropped at Book with 'This slot is no longer available'. This is D08 exactly.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots jump out of time order to the top of the grid, so the reading and focus order differs from what is on screen
grader_mapping.reason: The order:-1 on 'Few left' slots moves them in front of the chronological slots and above the Morning heading. Keyboard and screen-reader order then differs from what is on screen. This is D10.

grader_mapping.title: Slot buttons have no keyboard focus indicator
grader_mapping.reason: A style injected at run time (.slot:focus{outline:0}) removes the focus ring on the slot buttons only. This is D05.

grader_mapping.title: The slot grid runs off the screen on phones 360 px wide and below, and when zoomed
grader_mapping.reason: The resize script sizes three columns from the window width, ignoring padding and gaps, so the grid overflows at 360 px and below and the page scrolls sideways. This is D04.

grader_mapping.title: Van and trailer users only find out about the permit at the last step
grader_mapping.reason: The review covers the rule hidden behind an 'i' icon, the permit field that appears 1.2 s late, no check on the vehicle page, and the error only after Book with no link back. All of these are D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tags fail colour contrast in both themes
grader_mapping.reason: The review reports amber on amber at 3.0:1 in light mode and 3.4:1 in dark mode for 16 px bold text, below the 4.5:1 required. This is D03.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' loses the chosen day and doesn't say the rest of the booking is kept
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' returns to Today with no slot selected and doesn't say the details are kept. This is D12.

grader_mapping.title: The confirmation (done) page shows only the reference, not the day, time or vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, the slot and the vehicle the resident needs at the gate. This is D14.

grader_mapping.title: Slots blank for almost a second on every day change with no loading message, and Next silently does nothing
grader_mapping.reason: This is the wait itself: nothing says slots are coming, and Next does nothing in the meantime. That is D01.

grader_mapping.title: The slot-count live region is only switched on as the first result appears, so screen readers miss the first announcement
grader_mapping.reason: aria-live is added only after the count is written, so the screen reader is not told the slots have arrived or how many there are. This is D11.

grader_mapping.title: 'Today' is selected by default although most residents book the evening before
grader_mapping.reason: Residents who book the evening before, as the brief says most do, land on a day with nothing left to book and must notice and switch. With today's passed slots still shown as free, the default also steers them toward a slot that will be refused. Picking the default day is a separate problem from D06 and is not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: The arrival rule and the slot's end time are only in a tooltip that phones never show
grader_mapping.reason: The slot's end time and 'arrive within your slot' appear only in a title tooltip, so phone users never see them. This is D13.

grader_mapping.title: The 'Another day' date field opens a numbers-only iPhone keypad with no '/' while the hint asks for DD/MM/YYYY
grader_mapping.reason: A resident on an iPhone, the main device here, can't type the format the hint asks for. They may get stuck or give up choosing a date further ahead. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: The vehicle error isn't connected: the summary link targets an element that can't take focus, and the error isn't tied to the buttons
grader_mapping.reason: A keyboard or screen-reader user who follows 'Choose the vehicle' from the error summary doesn't land on the vehicle choice. They also aren't told the error when they reach the buttons, which makes the vehicle step harder to recover from. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: The waste hint about bag and mattress limits isn't read out by screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: The hint is attached through aria-describedby on a plain div, so screen-reader users miss the bag and mattress limits. They could then arrive with a load the gate refuses. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: Registration field should have autocapitalize='characters'
grader_mapping.reason: This is a polish suggestion. The review describes no harm, such as a rejected or mismatched registration, that it would prevent.

grader_mapping.title: A UK mobile number is required, so residents without one can't book online
grader_mapping.reason: The review reads the rule from the code: the field is required and accepts only UK mobiles. Residents with only a landline or a non-UK number are locked out of booking a council service online. Not in the ground truth.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag has low contrast (3.0:1 light, 3.4:1 dark)
grader_mapping.reason: First raised in the intro ('dark mode passes contrast everywhere except one tag (item 9)') and stated in full as item 9: '3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark, for 16 px text. It needs 4.5:1'. This is the D03 contrast failure.

grader_mapping.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking while the done page still says 'Booked'
grader_mapping.reason: Book 'waits 1.5 s and shows nothing visible', a second tap makes the booking 'saved with status "cancelled"', and the done page keeps the heading 'Booked' and a reference. This is exactly D09.

grader_mapping.title: Five-minute hold never mentioned and runs out without warning
grader_mapping.reason: 'The 5-minute hold is never mentioned, and it runs out without warning'; the resident only finds out after Book, from 'This slot is no longer available' with 'the slot blanked out'. This is the unseen hold running out in D08.

grader_mapping.title: Today opens by default and offers past or too-soon slots that are refused at the last step
grader_mapping.reason: 'Same-day slots less than about 30 minutes ahead get rejected, and only at the very last step after all the details have been typed.' This is D06's offered-then-refused slots.

grader_mapping.title: Today's date and the quick-day dates hard-coded in the bundle
grader_mapping.reason: The reviewer says itself 'I'm assuming this is fixture data, but it needs confirming', and the packet's scenario fixes today as Monday 12 October. It is a deployment check for the agency, not a problem the review shows residents meeting in the flow.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' / 'Back to the slots' reset to Today and silently move the booking
grader_mapping.reason: 'The slots page never reloads the day the resident already chose. It always resets to Today with nothing selected.' This is 'Change slot' forgetting the chosen day, D12.

grader_mapping.title: Van/trailer permit field appears late and unannounced; permit only checked on the confirm page
grader_mapping.reason: The permit field 'only appears 1.2 s later, without any announcement', is not checked on the vehicle page, and is 'only checked after tapping Book on the confirm page, where there's no permit field'. The mapping instructions assign the delayed field and the confirm-page permit error to D07.

grader_mapping.title: No focus outline on slot buttons
grader_mapping.reason: 'The script inserts `.slot:focus{outline:0}` ... so keyboard users can't see which slot they're on.' This is D05.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved out of time order to the top of the grid
grader_mapping.reason: 'Each one gets `order:-1`, so they all move to the top of the grid, above the "Morning" heading', while 'Screen-reader and keyboard order still follow the clock'. This is D10.

grader_mapping.title: Page scrolls sideways on 360 px phones
grader_mapping.reason: 'At 360 px and below, the script gives the slot grid fixed pixel columns that ignore the page padding, so the grid comes out about 30 px wider than the screen.' This is D04.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid empty for 0.9 s on a day change with no 'Loading slots…' message
grader_mapping.reason: 'Changing the day empties the slot grid for 0.9 s with no "Loading slots…" message': the grid is empty and nothing says slots are coming. That is the wait in D01 (a narrower statement of it).

grader_mapping.title: Status line only becomes a live region after the first load, so the first count is not announced
grader_mapping.reason: 'The status line only becomes a live region after the first load ... Screen-reader users hear nothing the first time.' This is D11.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle-page error summary links point at non-focusable divs (#vehicle, #waste)
grader_mapping.reason: The links 'go to `#vehicle` and `#waste`, which are divs that can't take focus', so a keyboard or screen-reader resident who follows an error link is not taken to the control to fix. No seeded defect covers this.

grader_mapping.title: Late errors on the confirm page (past slot, permit, centre closed) have no links to where they can be fixed
grader_mapping.reason: 'On the confirm page, the late errors (past slot, permit, centre closed) have no links to where they can be fixed.' A resident stuck at the last step with an error and no route to the fix is genuinely hurt, and the 'centre closed' case is not seeded. Adding links would not stop past slots being offered (D06) or fix the hidden permit rule and delayed field (D07), which the review reports separately as R4 and R7.

grader_mapping.title: Booking reference only on the done screen and in tab storage, not sent by text
grader_mapping.reason: 'The reference only exists on the done screen and in that browser tab's storage, and the centre has poor signal.' Residents must show it at the gate, so losing the tab loses the booking proof. D14 is about the missing day, slot and vehicle, not keeping the reference.

grader_mapping.title: 'Reminder the evening before' promise does not fit late bookings
grader_mapping.reason: Someone booking 'at 9 pm for tomorrow morning' has just seen the booking; the review shows no harm from the missing reminder beyond the wording.

grader_mapping.title: Slot end time and 'Arrive within your slot' only in a tooltip
grader_mapping.reason: 'The slot end time and "Arrive within your slot" are only in a `title` tooltip, which never shows on phones.' This is D13.

grader_mapping.title: Step list numbers read twice by screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: 'The step list is an `<ol>` and also has typed "1." "2." "3.", so screen readers read the numbers twice.' A small but genuine accessibility defect for blind residents, not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Waste hint not announced by screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: 'The waste hint is attached to a plain div, so screen readers don't announce it', so screen-reader residents miss the guidance on what waste they can bring. Genuine and not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Registration field does not autocapitalise
grader_mapping.reason: 'The registration field should use `autocapitalize="characters"`' is an input-convenience suggestion; the review shows no harm such as lowercase registrations being rejected.

grader_mapping.title: Theme colours set only by the script after load
grader_mapping.reason: 'If the script fails, the page has no theme at all' is speculative and depends on a script failure that would break the slot booking anyway; the review shows no harm in the working flow.

grader_mapping.title: Bundle sends nothing to a server; slots and reference invented, 'today' fixed (looks like a demo)
grader_mapping.reason: This describes how the delivered test build was put together, not a usability or accessibility problem in the booking flow. The review treats it as a scope question for the agency and reviews the flow as designed.

grader_mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking; no progress shown after the first tap
grader_mapping.reason: It is the same harm: Book shows nothing visible, a second press within 1.5 s cancels, and the done page still says 'Booked' with a reference.

grader_mapping.title: 5-minute hold runs out silently; misleading 'no longer available' message, slot blanked
grader_mapping.reason: It is the unseen five-minute hold that lapses and drops the slot to a dash, with the message never saying the hold ran out.

grader_mapping.title: Today's past and near-start slots look free but are rejected at Book
grader_mapping.reason: Today's slots before the 30-minute cut-off can be chosen and are refused only at the end, with no link. This is D06 exactly.

grader_mapping.title: Permit rule hidden behind an icon, field appears after 1.2 s, checked only on the confirm page
grader_mapping.reason: It covers the icon-only rule, the delayed permit field, Next accepting an empty permit, and enforcement only on the confirm page.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' / 'Back to the slots' lose the chosen day
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' reopens the first step on Today, forgetting the day and slot already chosen.

grader_mapping.title: No visible focus on slot buttons (injected outline:0)
grader_mapping.reason: The injected style removes the slots' focus ring, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved to the top, out of time order and out of focus/reading order
grader_mapping.reason: The CSS order moves 'Few left' slots to the front of the grid above the headings, while Tab and screen readers keep a different order.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid overflows sideways at 360 px and below
grader_mapping.reason: At 360 px and below the script sizes the columns from the window, so the grid runs past the edge, the right column is cut and the page scrolls sideways.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag low contrast in both themes
grader_mapping.reason: The amber 'Few left' tag measures about 3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark, against the 4.5:1 needed. The defect seeds about 3.0:1 and 3.2:1.

grader_mapping.title: Done page lacks the day, time, vehicle and arrival window
grader_mapping.reason: The done page shows only the reference and not the day, the slot or the vehicle booked.

grader_mapping.title: 20-minute arrival rule only in a hover tooltip phones never show
grader_mapping.reason: That a slot lasts 20 minutes and must be arrived within is only in the button's title tooltip, which never appears on a phone.

grader_mapping.title: Done page shows placeholder 'DR-000000' when the reference is missing
grader_mapping.reason: This is speculative. The review shows no way a resident in the normal flow reaches the done page without a reference. It appears only as a side note in the done-page fix.

grader_mapping.title: No 'Loading slots…' message while slots load; Next does nothing meanwhile
grader_mapping.reason: This is the wait itself: the slots vanish for about 0.9 s with no message, and Next gives no response.

grader_mapping.title: 'N slots free' status gets aria-live only after its first message
grader_mapping.reason: The status line becomes a live region only after it is first written, so the day's slot count is not announced.

grader_mapping.title: Error-summary links point to the #vehicle/#waste containers, not the controls
grader_mapping.reason: Following an error link puts keyboard and screen-reader residents on a container rather than the first input, so they have to hunt for the control to fix. The permit, hold and cut-off 'no link' part repeats R3-R5.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle choice uses aria-pressed toggle buttons instead of radio buttons
grader_mapping.reason: aria-pressed already exposes each option's state, and the review gives no failure a resident would hit. Preferring radios ('1 of 3') is a semantic preference.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle error not connected to the vehicle group
grader_mapping.reason: A screen-reader resident moving to the vehicle buttons is not told the error, so they may not know why the step won't go on or what to fix.

grader_mapping.title: Waste checkbox error replaces the rubble hint for screen readers
grader_mapping.reason: When the error shows, screen-reader residents lose the hint about rubble limits that they need to choose the waste correctly.

grader_mapping.title: Registration and postcode lack autocapitalize/spellcheck settings; autocorrect may mangle them
grader_mapping.reason: Residents mostly book on phones, where keyboard autocorrect and lower-case input can alter a registration or postcode. A wrong registration means the vehicle does not match the booking at the gate.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking; phone line only on weekdays 09:00-17:00
grader_mapping.reason: Residents mostly book in the evening, and those whose plans change cannot amend or cancel until a weekday office hour. They may waste a slot or arrive with the wrong booking.
